<thought>Search the template catalog using a simple aryl halide molecule and criteria that break an aryl halide and form a primary amine, which corresponds to an S_NAr reaction. This should return the SNAr template with its ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(F)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
